world_camera — DRIVE world op

• Data kinds: table × matrix × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.world_camera(world: 'dict', pose, K, width: 'int' = 640, height: 'int' = 400, *, light=(0.3, -0.5, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.35, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92), ego=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveworld; driveworld.world_camera(world: 'dict', pose, K, width: 'int' = 640, height: 'int' = 400, *, light=(0.3, -0.5, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.35, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92), ego=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("world_camera"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

世界をカメラで撮る: `{"color" (H,W,3), "label" (H,W) int(−1 = 空), "depth" (H,W), "face" (H,W), "shade" (H,W)}`。

render3d.render_mesh(attributes=True) の三角形 id から面の色・ラベルを引き、色は Lambert

(`ambient + (1−ambient)·max(n·l, 0)`、n は render3d のカメラ系法線を世界系に戻さず、光をカメラ系で与える)。

`ego=(V, F, color)` を渡すと自車のメッシュも一緒に描く(世界には足さない)。
